<div class="ppl-page" style="padding-top: 56px;">
# Meet our mentors

Senior modellers across the region have opened their calendars to mentor the next generation. Browse the wall, read what they love to work on, and contact who you'd like to learn from directly.

[Become a mentor ↗](join.html){.btn .btn-primary style="margin-top:20px; text-decoration:none;"}

```{=html}
<aside class="mm-cta" aria-label="Mentor matchmaker">
  <div class="mm-cta-art" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 520 520" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
      <defs>
        <radialGradient id="mm-o" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f5c6ff"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7410c6"/></radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="mm-c" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe6a1"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e08a00"/></radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="mm-e" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffb3c4"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e3325f"/></radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="mm-a" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b7ecd4"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#12a37a"/></radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="mm-n" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#a9d6ff"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1e5fb8"/></radialGradient>
      </defs>
      <circle cx="260" cy="160" r="120" fill="url(#mm-o)" opacity="0.85"/>
      <circle cx="170" cy="260" r="130" fill="url(#mm-c)" opacity="0.85"/>
      <circle cx="350" cy="260" r="125" fill="url(#mm-e)" opacity="0.85"/>
      <circle cx="210" cy="370" r="115" fill="url(#mm-a)" opacity="0.85"/>
      <circle cx="320" cy="370" r="120" fill="url(#mm-n)" opacity="0.85"/>
    </svg>
  </div>
  <div class="mm-cta-body">
    <div class="mm-cta-eye"><span class="dot"></span> Fun · 3 min · optional</div>
    <h3 class="mm-cta-h">Not sure whose style fits yours?</h3>
    <p class="mm-cta-p">Take a playful <b>Big Five</b> personality quiz and we'll suggest mentors whose character complements — not mirrors — your own. You'll also get an RPG-style character card to keep.</p>

</aside>

<style>
  .mm-cta {
    margin: 36px 0 4px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr;

    border-radius: 22px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(120% 140% at 0% 0%, rgba(116,16,198,0.08), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(120% 140% at 100% 100%, rgba(242,201,76,0.14), transparent 60%),
      #fff;
    border: 1px solid rgba(116,16,198,0.18);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px -24px rgba(116,16,198,0.35);
  }
  .mm-cta-art { width: 200px; max-width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
    animation: mm-float 9s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .mm-cta-art svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }
  @keyframes mm-float { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(-1.5deg)} }
  .mm-cta-eye {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;

  @keyframes mm-pulse { 0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(116,16,198,.55)} 80%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(116,16,198,0)} 100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(116,16,198,0)} }
  .mm-cta-h {
    font-family: "Space Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif;

</style>
```

```{=html}
<section class="ment-page">
  <!-- FILTER BAR -->
  <nav class="ment-filters" id="ment-filters" aria-label="Filter mentors" style="margin-top: 40px;">
    <div class="ment-fgroup">
      <span class="ment-flabel">Topic</span>
      <button class="chip on" data-f="topic" data-v="all">All</button>
      <button class="chip" data-f="topic" data-v="Dengue">Dengue</button>
      <button class="chip" data-f="topic" data-v="Malaria">Malaria</button>

    </div>
    <div class="ment-fgroup">
      <span class="ment-flabel">Country</span>
      <button class="chip on" data-f="country" data-v="all">All</button>
      <button class="chip" data-f="country" data-v="Thailand">Thailand</button>
      <button class="chip" data-f="country" data-v="Viet Nam">Viet Nam</button>
      <button class="chip" data-f="country" data-v="Indonesia">Indonesia</button>
      <button class="chip" data-f="country" data-v="Malaysia">Malaysia</button>
      <button class="chip" data-f="country" data-v="Singapore">Singapore</button>

      <button class="chip" data-f="country" data-v="Myanmar">Myanmar</button>
    </div>
    <div class="ment-fcount" id="ment-count">46 mentors</div>

  <!-- MENTOR WALL -->
  <div class="ment-wall" id="ment-wall" aria-live="polite"></div>

  <!-- DETAIL OVERLAY -->
  <div class="ment-overlay" id="ment-overlay" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="ment-sheet" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
      <button class="ment-close" aria-label="Close">×</button>
      <div class="ment-sheet-face" id="ov-face"></div>
      <div class="ment-sheet-body">
        <div class="ment-sheet-eye" id="ov-eye"></div>
        <h2 id="ov-name">—</h2>
        <div class="ment-sheet-role"><span id="ov-role">—</span> · <span id="ov-inst">—</span></div>
        <p id="ov-bio" class="ment-sheet-bio"></p>
        <div class="ment-sheet-meta">
          <div><div class="k">Based in</div><div class="v" id="ov-country">—</div></div>
          <div><div class="k">Mentoring since</div><div class="v" id="ov-since">—</div></div>
          <div><div class="k">Speaks</div><div class="v" id="ov-langs">—</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="ment-sheet-topics" id="ov-topics"></div>
        <div class="ment-sheet-quote" id="ov-quote"></div>
        <a class="btn btn-primary" id="ov-contact" href="#">Contact directly ↗</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
